beta_restrictions.daily_qa: daily-qa.html: DAILY_QA_MODEL_GENERATION = false. Only the two hand-checked questions open; a cached or generated draft that is not those two is refused.
beta_restrictions.daily_rc: daily-rc.html: DAILY_RC_MODEL_GENERATION = false. Only the hand-checked passage opens.
beta_restrictions.chat_rc: marg-app.js: BETA_VERIFIED_RC_ONLY = true. RC practice, RC Lab and guided RC open only the identified hand-checked passages; display backstops refuse any other RC.
beta_restrictions.disputed_varc: cat-bank-verification.js: cat-2024-s1-varc-q11 is withheld. Its content and key stay in the file.
beta_restrictions.unserved_qa: The unserved PYQ QA items are not in the served bank. They stay in the paper files and in this manifest, marked withheld_until_checked.
beta_restrictions.graded_practice: marg-app.js: BETA_VERIFIED_GRADED_ONLY = true. Graded QA and DILR open only from the deterministic constructors (engine certificate re-verified) or the hand-checked packs. Chat, guided, study-material and experiment generation are refused or rerouted; grading accepts verified_local and preverified keys only; cached QA/DILR sets need an engine certificate or an identical hand-checked pack.
beta_restrictions.daily_dilr: daily-dilr.html and daily-dilr/index.html redirect to the main app before any request; the main app opens checked DILR.
